name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2022 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2022 record supports: the CISA and partner advisories of the year (AA22-011A, AA22-054A, AA22-055A, AA22-074A, AA22-152A, AA22-158A, AA22-181A, AA22-249A, AA22-277A, AA22-294A, AA22-320A, AA22-321A, AA22-335A and others), Microsoft's profiles of DEV-0537 and the ransomware economy, the Cloudflare, Twilio, Uber and GitHub incident reports, ESET and Mandiant on the Ukraine attacks, and the ATT&CK objects the study binds. Revoked ids printed by the advisories are shown under their v20.0 successors from data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2022.md. Scores: 100 an opened source or ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id.
